prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE production icon atlas for Elements - Icons. The supplied image is a STYLE REFERENCE; replace its subjects with the subjects specified here.
Rustic, earnest old-fashioned COLOURED WOODCUT. Match the supplied references' warm black, dull ochre, clay/rust red, slate blue, muted olive and creamy carved cuts, but visibly simpler and less polished than the first reference: a small number of broad confident cuts, occasional knife slips, uneven angular contours, slightly crooked handmade things, thin missed patches in ink and colour plates shifted slightly beyond or short of their black outlines. Imperfect registration must look printed, not blurred. No smooth gradients, modeled digital shading, tiny decorative hatching, glossy highlights, outline stickers, cute toy proportions, circular badges, frames or presentation shadows. Humble functional objects, easily recognised at 56 pixels. Natural, clear silhouettes before texture. Transparent outside each object.
EXACTLY FIVE columns and FOUR rows, 20 equal cells, wide 5:4 atlas. Keep every complete subject centered in its own cell with at least 15% TRANSPARENT MARGIN from all cell boundaries; strict grid with clear wide gutters. No labels or numbering, no drawn grid, no text except where explicitly requested. Do not repeat objects from the reference unless listed. Make the states of related objects clearly different, using silhouettes and visible contents.
READING ORDER:
1. Dried fruit: Several irregular thin rust-red apple rings and wrinkled fruit slices on a small plain board
2. Floating lantern: Cream paper lantern with a small golden flame mounted on a broad simple wooden float, no water background
3. Watch lamp: Small ochre oil bowl enclosed by a plain glass wind shield with a carrying loop, visible fibre wick flame
4. Oil lamp: Shallow clay oil dish with a protruding fibre wick and small rust-gold flame, no glass or paper
5. Paper lantern frame: EMPTY simple rectangular thin wooden lantern frame with a few cream paper panels, no flame or float
6. Paper lantern: Same cream paper lantern glowing around a small oil flame, NO floating base
7. Return boats: 09:00 · 10:00 · 11:00: Cream departure sheet with a little blue sailboat at top and EXACTLY three clearly written rows: 09:00, 10:00, 11:00. This one icon may contain those numbers, no other lettering
8. Clock: Plain upright wooden clock case with a cream round dial, two dark hands and small visible pendulum below
9. Hourglass: Plain wooden-framed hourglass with TWO clear glass bulbs and ochre sand passing through a narrow waist
10. Pendulum: A heavy grey STONE bob suspended by a thin rope from a small bracket; two broad curved swing marks, no clock face
11. Clockwork: Three visibly meshing ochre wooden gears with a small escapement in an open square frame, no clock face
12. Mounted telescope: Long brass-and-wood telescope securely mounted on a tall three-legged wooden tripod
13. Star chart: Cream sheet showing a few simple black stars joined into constellations and a broad blue crescent, no text
14. Tripod: Empty three-legged wooden stand with a small mounting head, no telescope
15. Exhibition catalogue: Open cream booklet showing three small framed-picture thumbnails on its pages, one larger coloured river picture on cover
16. Mosaic: One flat square panel made of large irregular clay-red, slate-blue and ochre pieces forming a simple sun over a river
17. Arch: One plain freestanding cream stone arch with two sturdy uprights, no roof or pictures
18. Arcade: Three connected plain stone arches with a simple plank-covered walkway, no displayed pictures
19. Gallery: Same modest three-arch covered walkway with three visible coloured pictures hanging inside
20. Mosaic pieces: A loose cluster of irregular red, slate-blue and ochre glass tesserae, no assembled pattern
Keep all twenty separate, complete and rustic.
